description: PCSWMM Model Input Data for Multi criteria performance evaluation of stormwater infrastructure in a micro urban watershed Addis Ababa Ethiopia is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset comprises the complete PCSWMM 7.7 model input files used in the study. It includes a 22-sheet Excel file containing all necessary data for hydrological simulations in the study's 30-hectare micro-watershed. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
